sources.quote: Microsoft's lowest-end systems are getting upgrades to Qualcomm's latest Snapdragon X2 Plus processors.

headline: Microsoft refreshes Surface Pro 12 and Laptop 13 with new chips
summary: Microsoft refreshed its Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch, its lowest-end systems, with Qualcomm's Snapdragon X2 Plus chips. The devices keep last year's design and hardware but come with higher price tags.
